verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a local, self-contained document-conversion CLI and Haskell library that reads input and writes output files or stdout. It is not a hosted service that holds user data, so service-side data retention and deletion controls are outside its product category. The optional pandoc-server mode is self-hosted by the user, and nothing in the evidence shows Pandoc retaining data in a way that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
